stories.title: John Summers Clock Tower to open for tours on Saturday to mark 130 years of Shotton steelworks
stories.summary: The John Summers Clock Tower at the former Shotton steelworks will open to the public on Saturday (10 October) to mark 130 years since the works opened. stories.title: UK Government letter to Uniper asks if Connah’s Quay power station plan does enough for Dee Estuary wildlife
stories.summary: The UK Government has written to Uniper asking whether its plans would make up for the saltmarsh and curlew habitat that would be lost to a new power station at Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Wok & Go franchise boss from Higher Kinnerton given suspended sentence for breaching director ban

stories.title: Plans submitted to demolish and rebuild Latter-day Saints church on St David’s Park, Ewloe
stories.summary: A church that opened in Ewloe in 2005 could be demolished and replaced with a building about twice the size, under plans submitted to Flintshire County Council.
